# Terrence Boyd — VP Operations

- **Relationship:** Ray's direct report; runs supply chain, maintenance, and industrial
  engineering across the network. Reports alongside — not under — Sandra on the leadership team.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Tuesdays 10:00.
- **Owns:** the [HydraForce capacity expansion](../projects/hydraforce-capacity-expansion.md) and
  the [HydraFlow line launch](../projects/hydraflow-line-launch.md); the supplier relationship
  with [Cascade Castings](../people/bob-nguyen.md).
- **Distinguishing fact:** 20-year Brandt veteran; knows every machine on the Rockford floor.

## How to work with him
- Detail-deep; give him time to work a problem rather than a snap decision.
- The person to ask about casting lead times and the single-source risk on ductile iron.

## Sensitivities
- Frustrated that the [Compass ERP](../projects/erp-modernization.md) slip is scrambling his MRP
  and purchasing plans.
